name: set_camera_distance

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetCameraDistance converts the top stack value to float, stores it in D_003C0E80, rebuilds the camera through func_001C8170, and decrements Script stackTop

notes: func_001C8170 uses D_003C0E80 as the Z component of an offset vector, rotates that vector by the camera angles, and adds it to the target position to produce D_002DECE0. func_001C7FE0 initializes the same field with the Euclidean distance between the current camera position and target. All 97 JP calls pass a direct literal: 80, 250, 340, 400, or 500. The preceding camera command is always command 37 set_camera_rotation_degrees (73 calls) or command 35 (24 calls).
